_comment: Hand-kept half of the firstmate team diagram. Everything a plugin can say about itself (version, commands, subagents, MCP tools, hooks, routing) is read from the repo by team_diagram.py; only what the repo cannot say lives here. Regenerate with: python integrations/firstmate/team_diagram.py
title: firstmate crew — who does what

does: Sets the intent for every task
Answers the questions a crewmate stops on
Approves anything irreversible: board creation, GitHub writes beyond a delivery contract
Turns the Captain's intent into a spec and one brief per task
Sets the delivery contract: how far a crewmate may write to remotes
Dispatches crewmates, reads their reports, relays open questions
Tears a crewmate down when its task ends
owns: Parallelism: how many crewmates run at once
Code changes, built in slices that stay green
Ticket, branch, PR and board card, as far as the delivery contract allows
A proved root cause before any fix
The failing regression test, written first
The first bad commit of a regression
Severity-ranked findings on every diff before push
Ship / ship-with-changes / hold verdict on a PR (scout)
Backlog readiness: value, acceptance criteria, size
Splitting items sized 13+ into vertical slices
Proposes GitHub writes in its report, never makes them

crew_note: Every crewmate is one Claude Code session with all crew plugins loaded. A role is the plugin brief-include.md routes that kind of work to, so one ship crewmate usually plays Developer, then Code Reviewer, then Developer again. Firstmate can run several crewmates side by side.
gaps: No crew skill creates a GitHub Projects board, its columns or fields: ship-change's board.py only lists boards, adds cards and moves them
Scrum Master writes nothing to GitHub, so filing the stories it refines falls to a ship crewmate (Developer) or the Captain

rows.activity: Write spec, brief and delivery contract
Create the project board (no skill yet)
Refine raw items into ready stories
File issues and put them on the board
Open PR, move card to In review

scenario.title: Example — a new project needs a board and a first backlog

steps.text: Intent: new project X. Create its board and a first backlog from these notes
Spec, then two briefs in parallel. T1 scout → backlog draft. T2 ship → board. Contract T2: create the board only
/scrum-master:refine each raw idea → user-value story, testable criteria, size
Create board by hand: gh project create + Status columns Backlog → Ready → In progress → In review → Done
story-splitter subagent splits 13+ items; readiness check on each story
board.py boards confirms it; report the project number N
/scrum-master:backlog-health → report with proposed gh issue create commands, no writes
Merge both reports; relay open questions
Ship brief T3: file the approved stories. Contract: issues and board cards only
gh issue create per story; board.py add --project N; board.py move --status Ready
/scrum-master:plan-sprint → sprint goal, capacity, issues that fit (proposal)
One ship brief per sprint ticket
